courses.title: Advanced Abnormal Psychology
courses.currentVersionBinding: The active provider names SDCM-0178 and Psychology 306. Its disorder classification, assessment, treatment and ethical/legal outcomes agree with the current version-3 ACE exhibit, whose selected period is May 1, 2024 through May 31, 2027. The older version-2 recommendation ended April 30, 2024; an April 2027 end date from secondary summaries was not substituted for the actual selected primary period.

courses.title: Psychology of Learning
courses.currentVersionBinding: The active provider names SDCM-0183 and Psychology 314. Its integrative learning-theory objective and research, cognition, memory, culture and real-world application outcomes match ACE version 2. The current ACE index links January 2026 through December 2028 to that exact exhibit.

assessmentReviewNote: Psychology 306 currently requires two assignments, chapter tests and an open-book unproctored final, with 70% overall and no separate component floor. Psychology 314's specific syllabus requires three assignments and chapter assessments and expressly excludes a final; its generic marketing final-exam sentence does not override that syllabus. Its ACE minimum passing score is 70; no separate provider-specific passing rule is inferred from silence in that syllabus.
